## History

During a room visit with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) after he was sent to bed without dinner for lying, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defended [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) when [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) argued that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) had lied about God punishing those who skip prayers. Later, following Opal's peaceful death, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walked home from the funeral discussing God and the afterlife with Isolde and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md).

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P63](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0063), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), +2 more_
